sourcePreparation: git archive exact sourceCommit extracted into two separate temporary trees, each clean target; both mounted /work
cacheControlLimitation: Host directories named tmp-cargo/default-cargo contain source checkouts mounted at /work, not cache mounts. Cargo caches remain container-local at their chosen CARGO_HOME; default image may include prepopulated cache contents whereas /tmp/cargo starts empty. Package versions are lockfile-controlled, but cache contents were not independently normalized or compared. The experiment isolates the selected CARGO_HOME configuration, not every byte of its initial cache state.
buildCommand: cargo build --release --locked -p arena-supervisor --bin arena-job-broker --bin arena-worker --bin arena-reaper
conclusion: CARGO_HOME change demonstrably changes broker/worker bytes and embedded registry paths, not reaper bytes. /tmp variant reproduces all current hashes; neither variant matches any historical pin. This does not explain historical mismatch. No claim of fully reproducible recipe; only one fresh clean build per variant, plus prior nonclean current build match. No gate/pin/installation changes.
